purpose: Fail-closed no-GT audit of V9 frontier execution outcomes with exact planner-target schemas and a bijection between every verified traversal and one decision transition. V1, V1R and V1R2 were superseded unexecuted after validation reviews.

approval.scope: One immutable read-only V1R3 audit of all 30 V9 traces and snapshots in the exact finalized 90-case source; no simulation, bag/GT/map read, training, selection, tuning or source mutation.
approval.confirmation_reference: Standing autonomous authorization for the fixed paper scope.

sampling.independent_analysis_unit: one V9 closed-loop case within the frozen world-by-environment-seed block design

method.identity_validation: Validate exact row/case/frame/arc/update/current/final-node identities, exact planner target keys/modes/values, acyclic paths and source-generator hashes.
method.verified_transition: Validate every traversal endpoint, interval, arc and frame count; bind its start/end rows to from/to nodes; require a one-to-one and onto mapping between all traversals and all inter-node decision transitions.
method.target_state_contract: Bind historical observed-only eligibility to the exact frozen planner because final append-only snapshots do not record stub creation frames.
method.persistence: Use only frozen waypoint-lookahead and minimum-event-travel scales; select no threshold.
method.run_identity: Require exact create_run spec/card/command/RUN_STATE/status and host/Python identity; reject future timestamps without imposing an arbitrary maximum delay.

failure_policy: Fail on any source/generator drift, malformed target, unmatched/duplicate/unused traversal or transition, aggregate mismatch, provenance drift, source write, bag/GT/map read, training, selection or C09/C10 read.
expected_evidence: 90-case sealed source manifest and 60 V9 trace/snapshot hashes
30 exact-schema and traversal-bijective V1R3 per-case audits
recomputed outcome and frozen-scale persistence totals

estimated_cost.compute: Read-only CPU JSON audit; zero Gazebo, ROS, GPU, training or bag decompression.
